name: Old Ironforge Incursion
summary: Beneath Ironforge, Earthseer Farsen sends you to the Hall of Thanes for the last part of the investigation. There, you face the Dark Iron threat and report to King Magni Bronzebeard.

sections.title: Breaching the Vaults
sections.body: The underground map reveals Dark Iron movements, and Earthseer Farsen identifies the mastermind behind the intrusion. The entrance to the Hall of Thanes lies deep within Old Ironforge's ancient stone halls. While the upper city tends to matters on the surface, Dark Iron forces slip into caverns that lie dormant beneath the kingdom.

sections.title: Durgen Dirgehammer
sections.body: Earthseer Farsen translates captured Dark Iron documents and names the commander: Durgen Dirgehammer. Deep in the lower vaults, Durgen threatens the heart of the Bronzebeard mountain kingdom. Reach him, strike him down, and carry his severed head to King Magni Bronzebeard above.

sections.title: Audience with the King
sections.body: Durgen Dirgehammer's head confirms to King Magni Bronzebeard the Dark Iron threat beneath the city's ancient roots. You bring proof of victory and a personal greeting from Farsen, Magni's old friend. The investigation ends with Magni aware of what lurks below.

faq.answer: Earthseer Farsen sends you into the Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge to face the Dark Iron commander, Durgen Dirgehammer. It is the last stage of an investigation into Dark Iron activity beneath Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: You enter the Hall of Thanes, an ancient chamber deep in the bedrock beneath Old Ironforge and the mountain capital.
Durgen Dirgehammer commands the Dark Iron incursion into the Hall of Thanes beneath Old Ironforge. Earthseer Farsen learned his name from recovered Dark Iron documents.

faq.q: Who gives the quest, and who receives it?
aliases: who turns in old ironforge incursion
faq.answer: After you recover the Underground Map, Earthseer Farsen sends you to King Magni Bronzebeard in Ironforge.

faq.q: How do I start the quest chain that leads to this?
aliases: how to start hall of thanes quest
faq.answer: Begin with A Visitor to Dun Morogh, offered by Beldin Steelgrill outside Kharanos in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: What is the connection between Earthseer Farsen and King Magni?
faq.answer: Earthseer Farsen considers himself an old friend of King Magni Bronzebeard. He asks you to send his personal regards when you present Durgen Dirgehammer's head in the throne room.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know Dark Iron infiltrators have violated your ancestral fortress in the forgotten vaults beneath the High Seat.
As an Alliance member, you help stop an incursion that threatens a devastating surprise attack on your faction's primary stronghold in the Eastern Kingdoms.
